How we work

A clear purpose. An agreed role. A practical way forward.

You can begin with a specific question, an opportunity or a business challenge. Together, we define the work, the contribution SetuHashi will make and how we will assess progress.

Working together

Keep the purpose, people and progress connected.

  1. 1

    Agree on what matters

    We establish the intended business benefit, the outputs we will deliver and the decisions the work should support.

  2. 2

    Bring the right capabilities together

    We identify what you and your partners already bring, what else is needed and who will undertake each part.

  3. 3

    Keep progress visible

    We agree on milestones, review points and how issues will be raised. Progress is assessed against the assignment’s purpose, alongside delivery of the agreed work.

  4. 4

    Adapt deliberately

    If circumstances change, we discuss the implications. Changes to scope, roles or commitments are agreed rather than assumed.

The working arrangements should suit the assignment: a short assessment needs a different rhythm from an initiative involving several organizations.
